tools.name: alkemata-get-site-info
tools.description: Returns public identity and interface URLs for Alkemata.

tools.name: alkemata-search-published-content
tools.description: Searches published Alkemata posts or pages and returns public metadata only.

tools.name: alkemata-get-published-content
tools.description: Returns one published Alkemata post or page by numeric ID.

tools.name: alkemata-get-agent-guidance
tools.description: Returns authoritative public references and read-only operating rules for agents.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "alkemata-public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: alkemata-get-site-info, alkemata-search-published-content, alkemata-get-published-content · Public sink: alkemata-get-published-content.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: alkemata-get-site-info, alkemata-search-published-content, alkemata-get-published-content · Public sink: alkemata-get-published-content

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
